info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Servicing Customer Case-spec
info.description: The Customer Case Management API provides a streamlined process for submitting and managing servicing cases for customers. This API allows businesses to create detailed records of customer interactions, issues, and resolutions, enhancing customer service efforts. Typical consumers include customer support teams and banking operations that require efficient case handling. By leveraging this API, companies can improve their responsiveness to customer needs and maintain high-quality service levels.

post.description: This endpoint allows users to create a new customer case by providing the necessary details. Ensure that all required fields are filled out accurately to avoid validation errors.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to create a customer case in the servicing system. It accepts detailed information regarding the case, including customer information, case details, and any associated attributes required for processing.
